stem: Ananya makes a model of the Solar System for her school exhibition in Jaipur. Her teacher says the model must include only objects that truly belong to the Solar System and that the other bodies in it shine by reflecting sunlight. Which statement should Ananya use for her model?

options.text: The Moon belongs to the Solar System because it produces its own light, just like the Sun.
The Solar System is made of the Sun, eight planets, their moons, and smaller objects such as asteroids and comets; the planets and moons shine by reflecting sunlight.
Only the Sun and the eight planets belong to the Solar System; moons, asteroids and comets are not part of it.
Sirius belongs to the Solar System because it looks very bright in the night sky.

teacher.key_rationale: B is the only statement matching the enrichment rule: the Solar System comprises the Sun, eight planets, their moons, and smaller objects (asteroids, comets), with bodies other than the Sun shining by reflected sunlight. A wrongly gives the Moon its own light; C wrongly excludes moons and comets; D wrongly counts the star Sirius as a member based on apparent brightness.
